Harlow release may be understated: direct Youth spend 210,000 (255,600 with allocated shared) vs 160,000 per schedule; alternative split 115,000 / 235,000 shown
City grant 30,000 unspent at the end of its year: possible right of return / liability
Total releases 340,000 netting to zero; closing restricted 165,000, unrestricted 185,000; roll-forward ties
Functional split: programme 571,200 (91.4%), M&G 17,100 (2.7%), fundraising 36,700 (5.9%); 18.2% allocated on judgment; rent split on staff time not floor area
skill_defects: references/method.md 'Step 3 — Track and release restrictions' says 'purpose restrictions release as qualifying costs are incurred, capped at the restricted amount' but gives no rule for when a donor's own 'spent on purpose' figure is lower than the qualifying programme spend (Harlow 160,000 vs Youth 210,000), nor for ordering opening restricted balances against new gifts from the same donor.

references/method.md 'Step 2 — Recognize contributions and grants' covers conditional vs unconditional but not a grant that combines a met condition with a time-bound purpose and unspent funds at the end of the period (City grant 30,000), where a right of return may make the balance a liability.

SKILL.md 'Upload path — hand over one checklist' requires opening and closing trial balances, yet the only sample input is a summary; the skill relies on the generic protocol rule ('A summary arrives where the checklist asks for a listing') with no statement of which statements (cash flow) the summary cannot support.
sample_defects: Harlow 'spent on purpose' 160,000 while Youth programme expenses are 210,000 direct and 295,000 of Harlow money (95,000 b/f + 200,000) was available; nothing says why 50,000 of Youth spend does not qualify, so the key's 160,000 release rests on the schedule alone.

City grant is for the 'year to June 2025' with 150,000 - 120,000 = 30,000 unspent at 30 June 2025; the sample is silent on whether it is returnable, which decides whether it is restricted net assets or a liability.
Programme expenses are given as one line per programme with no natural classification, so the required natural x functional matrix cannot be built.
summary: PASS 3/3: rota rejected on content; releases 340,000 proposed (Harlow 160,000), City condition met, staff-time split applied; Harlow spend figure ambiguous in sample.
